headline: Cortex CLI and MCP server docs restructured; EDL root certificate switches to DigiCert
summary_md:
- The **Cortex CLI** section moved to `about-cortex-cli` and the **Cortex MCP server** overview collapsed into its parent, renaming 19 pages between them — bookmarks break.
- Twelve pages are new, ten of them net: CLI installation and post-install management, `parse_cef()` and `parse_json()` for parsing rules, a **Data Ingestion** dashboard reference, and three XDR Collector profile pages.
- Acting on today: EDL setup needs the DigiCert root certificate, scheduled correlations are capped at 1,200, and data ingestion health monitoring is now labelled BETA.
- Quieter churn: ~25 Cloud Security pages changed only their front-matter `description`, and 30 Linux kernel tables gained newly supported kernel versions.

highlights.title: The root certificate for EDL setup changed from GoDaddy to DigiCert
highlights.detail: The download link moved from `gdroot-g2.crt` to DigiCert Global Root G2, so an EDL configured from the old page trusts the wrong root.

highlights.title: New Amazon ECS EC2 agent installation package
highlights.detail: The installer downloads as a JSON task definition for agent 9.1 or later on x86_64 or ARM64, and must be deployed as a Daemon service so one agent task runs per container instance.

highlights.title: Scheduled correlations are capped at 1,200 active rules
highlights.detail: The limit counts only enabled, user-created scheduled correlations and is now stated on both the create and manage pages.

highlights.title: Data ingestion health monitoring is now labelled BETA
highlights.detail: Three limitations are stated: it does not distinguish ingestion lag from data loss, auto-generated health issues are not dispatched or grouped into cases, and as orphan issues they cannot trigger playbook automation.

highlights.title: The XQL bin stage gains bins, timeshift and timezone
highlights.detail: `span` is now optional against a new `bins=` count, `timeshift`/`timezone` set the grouping origin — but `comp`, `view` and the stage index all now link to `bin` as `broken-reference`.

highlights.title: Cortex CLI pages moved under About Cortex CLI
highlights.detail: Sixteen pages were renamed from `cortex-cli/` to `about-cortex-cli/`, with `authenticate-credentials` pushed a level deeper under Connect Cortex CLI and the API Security page rewritten in place.

items.xsiam/detect-investigate-and-respond-to-: The certificate to download is now DigiCert Global Root G2 instead of GoDaddy gdroot-g2, and the section heading became Prerequisites.
items.xsiam/protect-your-endpoints/endpoint-se: Adds an Amazon ECS EC2 installer with its own prerequisites table, IAM role requirements and deployment steps for the ECS console.
items.xsiam/detect-investigate-and-respond-to-: Adds the 1,200 active scheduled correlation limit next to the existing auto-disable of rules reaching 5,000 or more hits.
items.xsiam/configure-cortex-xsiam/cortex-xsia: Retitled BETA, with a new limitations section covering lag versus loss, undispatched health issues and no playbook automation.
items.xql/readme/stages/bin: Documents binning by quantity via bins=, the timeshift and timezone options for span=, the eight supported time suffixes, and three new examples.
items.xsiam/reference-and-developer-docs/about: New page covering Homebrew, Scoop, manual download and UI-generated installation, including how to pin a release line or exact version.
New page for upgrading, pinning and uninstalling the CLI, plus a script that pulls signed release downloads from the public API.
Re-added at the new path rather than renamed, and now carries the authentication file schema and Java 11 prerequisite.
items.xsiam/configure-cortex-xsiam/cortex-mcp-: Absorbs the deleted overview page, and its install, client-configuration and usage pages moved up one level to sit directly beneath it.
items.xsiam/configure-cortex-xsiam/data-manage: New page documenting parse_cef(), which turns a CEF string into a key/value object inside an INGEST section; parse_json() was added alongside it.
items.xsiam/detect-investigate-and-respond-to-: New reference page for the Data Ingestion dashboard, stating that the Ingestion Rate widget counts third-party and external sources.
items.xsiam/configure-cortex-xsiam/cortex-xsia: The Filebeat, Winlogbeat and Settings procedures moved out into three new child pages.
items.xsiam/protect-your-endpoints/endpoint-se: Temporary exceptions are now simply limited to 48 hours; the clause saying they were configurable up to one week is gone.
items.xsiam/configure-cortex-xsiam/cortex-xsia: Says Cortex XSIAM instead of Cortex Cloud, and the auth tabs collapse to Access Key or Assumed Role while the prerequisites still describe Workload Federated Identity.
items.developer/cortex-xsiam-development-guide: send_events_to_xsiam() is no longer described as failing from a custom integration; it should be used with system integrations, with HTTP Log Collector as the alternative.
